metadata.notes: PR 3.4cd Cross-Table specialist exercise. The constrained _fixture schema (single source/target table, id+name → id+label) does NOT support genuine cross-table FK testing — the schema would need additional source tables. Within this constraint, the fixture uses business_context to describe a hypothetical cross-table scenario and asserts the Critic surfaces a missed_mapping critique IF the agent fails to identify the cross-table relationship the business_context describes. Phase 3.8 cohort eval will replace this with a richer multi-table-source fixture. Score interpretation: 1.0 if Critic surfaces missed_mapping (correctly identifying the cross-table opportunity).
metadata.business_context: The source 'name' field on fixture_source_table actually stores the REGION NAME of the customer's primary region (denormalized from a related region table that was joined-and-flattened during the legacy export). The target 'label' field on fixture_target_table is the canonical region display name for the target system. The mapping name → label is correct as a one-to-one denormalized mapping; the original cross-table structure (customer → region.name) is preserved in this flattened form. Treat this as a legitimate one_to_one mapping, NOT a cross_table tag.
